header.title: How to Calibrate Your Digital Weight Scale
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to calibrate your digital weight scale to ensure accurate measurements. Follow the process to enter calibration mode, perform a test, and finalize the calibration.

steps.description: Turn on the digital weight scale and allow it to warm up, ensuring to use objects with a definite weight for calibration.
actions: Turn on the digital weight scale
Use objects with a definite weight

steps.description: This step instructs the user to enter calibration mode on the digital weight scale by pressing a specific button until a calibration indicator appears.
actions: Identify the button label (Cal, Function, Mode, or Cal/Mode)

steps.description: Place approximately 30 pounds of known weight objects onto the digital scale for calibration.
actions: Put known weight objects on the digital scale.
Ensure the objects amount to roughly 30 pounds.
Place the objects without wobbling or movement.
Place the objects on the central part of the scale.

steps.description: Allow the digital scale to take a measurement, then end the calibration session.
actions: Allow the digital scale to take in the measurement.
Press the calibration button once more to end the session.
Check for 'End', '0', or 'Cal' on the digital scale’s monitor.
If the scale does not reset automatically, switch off the scale.
Leave the scale switched off for at least two minutes.
